name: Lootom Telcovideo Network (wuxi) Co., Ltd.
summary: Lootom Telcovideo Network (wuxi) Co., Ltd. provides solutions and services for network operators. It offers professional network planning and design, optimization and transformation, operation and maintenance monitoring, engineering construction, and other services. The company also provides transmission construction products, such as HFC, PON, EOC, and DOCSIS; fusion terminal products, including smart gateway and set top boxes, as well as IPTV/OTT terminals; and smart tourism data integration and sharing center, comprehensive management, one-stop service, and full network marketing solutions, as well as full ecological smart safe community overall solutions. Lootom Telcovideo Network (wuxi) Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Wuxi, China.
